title: Apply the D1 migrations once, not once per test file
description:
Measured on the operator's run of cloud/factory's suite: 345.57s total, of which SETUP IS 97.81s - transform is 10.31s and tests are 158.80s. The setup is test/apply-migrations.ts, which applies the deploy-authored migration set (16 migrations) and is registered as vitest's setupFiles, so it runs ONCE PER TEST FILE across 53 files. Roughly 1.8s x 53 spent re-applying the same schema to a fresh D1.

The file is correct as written - it leans on applyD1Migrations being idempotent and says so - it is just paid 53 times. Candidate shapes: seed one D1 and share it, snapshot after migration and restore per file, or apply in a global setup rather than a per-file one. Which is available depends on @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers' isolation model, so measure before committing to one.

Do not fix this by weakening isolation: the per-file fresh database is what stops one file's rows reaching another, and tick 5qj's comment records real corruption when files shared state. A faster setup that reintroduces cross-file bleed is a worse trade than the 97 seconds.

2026-10-07 23:35 - ticfac run epic-t8u: uhe try 1 (run dispatch #15) reported a finding the run itself decided — proposed-tick "cloudflare:test's per-file import is the vitest suite's dominant cost; no tick owns it" (key 351fef2de2be83c6b16decb16941c8c53d389f29296491e83bd4b58bc900b7fd, severity medium, for this repository) is promoted to a backlog tick with an owner, 9fn; the decision record is on the run branch at .ticfac/runs/epic-t8u/absorptions/351fef2de2be83c6b16decb16941c8c53d389f29296491e83bd4b58bc900b7fd.json, and the draft is triaged as promoted.
2026-10-07 23:35 - Attempt 15 (2026-10-07, pool-workers 0.22.0 / vitest 4.1.11, 80 files, 28 migrations) re-measured this tick on the runtime the suite now runs. The 97.81s of `setup` this tick was written against was the setup file's `cloudflare:test` import, not the migrations — dropped by 2b4e3c445 before this attempt; setup is 1.08s per suite run (vitest's own summary, host load ~22) and 1.38s on the 82-file tree attempt 15 leaves (the two new guard files' own setup). 'Once per run rather than once per file' is structurally unavailable on this runtime: each test file boots its own workerd with an in-memory D1 (one `Starting runtime` per file under NODE_DEBUG=vitest-pool-workers), so there is no shared database to seed, and vitest's only shared-runner switch (`isolate: false`) is the cross-file bleed this tick forbids. The per-file apply costs ~9ms over the setup-module floor (single-file medians: empty setup 16ms / import-only 59ms / as written 68ms). test/d1-file-isolation-a.test.ts and -b.test.ts now prove per-file isolation from inside the suite — green serially, red under `--isolate=false` — which is the clause the existing suite could not prove on its own.
2026-10-07 23:40 - ticfac run epic-t8u: uhe try 1 (run dispatch #15) merged into epic/t8u as 255f534ca55b; the integrated gate (go, ts) passed.
acceptance_criteria: The migration set is applied once per run rather than once per file, and the suite's reported setup time drops materially (report before and after from vitest's own summary). Every test still sees a schema-correct database with no rows from another file, proven by the existing suite passing unchanged.
